_note: Bars for tests/run_motion_tests.gd, the motion gate (D-177 'Motion first'). They guard bugs, not balance (D-385): one set of bars for every stage, no per-stage cadence. slide_max (units/s) and aloft_yaw_max (deg): measured 0.00 at every stage, bars sit just above zero. catch_straight: catch steps a second walking straight, measured 0, one step in the 5 s window is 0.2. catch_turn_smooth: the young croc's smooth turns (D-131), measured worst 1.00 (turn180), bar held at the 2026-10-23 lead ruling. step_tol: the sim's step vs half the clip's stride, measured 0.0% Behemoth, 0.2% Colossus. jerk_walk/jerk_turn: shin jerk p99 in deg/frame^2, one knee-pop ceiling for every stage (D-385: the loosest of the old per-stage bars, Behemoth 5.0 / 8.0; measured on 1f23937a walk 2.7/4.3/1.0, worst turn 4.83/6.95/5.36). stretch_max: planted hip-ankle reach as a share of leg length, measured worst 0.93. pivot_max / centre_max: hip heights, measured worst 0.06 / 0.48. lift_min/lift_max: the walk clip's toe-tip rise as a share of hip height, one range for every stage (D-385): the feet do lift (1.5%) and never kick up past a fifth of the hip (20%; the Dracorex study's 13% fits; the 36-bone baby walk measured 1.6%, director 2026-10-30).
